broadcasts.message: normalize.js ready: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single space, trim. No word changes. Using String.prototype.normalize (ES6+), available in QuickJS. Awaiting tokenizer/pipeline integration.

Tokenizer implemented: tokenize(text) calls injected normalize(text), then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g. Preserves order and all tokens. Ready to integrate with normalize and pipeline.

pipeline.js implemented. Uses injected tokenize directly. Frequencies uses null-prototype object to handle constructor safely. Unique preserves first-seen order. text is tokens joined by single space. Ready for integration.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1: I own normalize.js. Spec: normalize(text) must NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. Do not alter words. No extra functions, no shadowing normalize/tokenize. Peers: tokenizer.js injects normalize, pipeline.js injects tokenize. I must return JSON with files={normalize.js}, memory, message. Next rounds may need adjustments if peers report interface issues.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: I am implementing tokenizer.js per spec. Must call injected normalize(text) exactly once, extract ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes. Keep order, no filtering. Need to be careful not to shadow normalize. Will review peer interfaces later.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I own pipeline.js. Must implement processText(text) using injected tokenize. Return {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies} with prototype-safe frequencies object. Use Object.create(null) for frequencies. text = tokens.join(' '). tokens = tokenize(text). unique = first-seen distinct tokens. count = tokens.length. No shadowing of tokenize. No extra functions exported. Ready.
